environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. The inventory SQLite database at /var/lib/inventory/products.db contains product data and a 'users' table with credentials. Container filesystem is writable (default). The CLI tool is invoked via a task scheduler that passes user-supplied search terms from an internal web form. No input validation middleware.

config.database: SQLite at /var/lib/inventory/products.db with products and users tables
config.invocation: Scheduled task with user-supplied arguments from internal form
